title: Social Media & Influencer Marketing Intern
skills: Social media content management: Support the execution of organic social media strategies, helping coordinate content calendars, publications, captions and creative assets across different platforms and financial products.
Influencer marketing support: Assist with influencer campaigns, including creator research, profile evaluation, deliverable tracking, content reviews and publication follow-ups.
Agency coordination: Support daily communication with social media and influencer marketing agencies, following up on pending deliverables, timelines, feedback and approvals.
Content reviews & approvals: Help review creative assets, captions, influencer scripts and publications to ensure consistency with brand guidelines, product messaging and approved communication.
Campaign execution & tracking: Maintain updated calendars, trackers and status reports for social media and influencer campaigns, ensuring deadlines and deliverables are met.

Performance monitoring & reporting: Collect and organize key metrics such as reach, impressions, engagement, views and follower growth; support the preparation of weekly and monthly performance reports.
Social listening & trend monitoring: Identify relevant social media trends, viral formats, competitor activities and content opportunities that could inspire new ideas and improve engagement.
Community management support: Assist in monitoring comments, mentions and audience interactions, identifying relevant insights and escalating questions or potential issues to the appropriate teams.
Administrative & operational support: Help organize campaign documentation, influencer databases, presentations, budget trackers and other administrative tasks related to marketing initiatives.
Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Brand, Product, Design Hub, Operations, Legal, Procurement and other internal teams to support campaign execution and alignment.
Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Digital Media, Business or a related field.
Strong interest in social media, influencer marketing, digital content and emerging trends.
Familiarity with Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, including content formats, trends and platform dynamics.
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint or Google Workspace (Sheets, Slides and Drive).
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Proactive attitude, creativity, willingness to learn and ability to work collaboratively.
Fluent Spanish and high-intermediate English.
Availability to work part-time according to the internship program requirements.
Previous internship experience or academic projects related to social media, content creation, digital marketing or influencer campaigns.
Familiarity with social media metrics such as engagement rate, reach, impressions and follower growth.
Basic knowledge of Canva, CapCut or other content editing tools.
Experience creating content for TikTok, Instagram Reels or other social media platforms.
Interest in fintech, financial services and consumer brands.
description:
About The Company

DiDi Global Inc. is the world’s leading mobility technology platform. It offers a wide range of app-based services across markets including Asia-Pacific, Latin America and Africa, including ride hailing, taxi hailing, chauffeur, hitch and other forms of shared mobility as well as auto solutions, food delivery, intra-city freight, and financial services.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

We are looking for a proactive, creative and detail-oriented Social Media & Influencer Marketing Intern to support the planning, execution and monitoring of social media content and influencer marketing campaigns for all Fintech Products.

This role will take part of the Social Media team, supporting daily operations, agency coordination, content management, campaign tracking and performance reporting across platforms such as Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube.

The ideal candidate is passionate about social media, digital trends and content creation, with strong organizational skills, attention to detail and an eagerness to learn in a fast-paced environment.

In this role, you'll be...


Social media content management: Support the execution of organic social media strategies, helping coordinate content calendars, publications, captions and creative assets across different platforms and financial products.
Influencer marketing support: Assist with influencer campaigns, including creator research, profile evaluation, deliverable tracking, content reviews and publication follow-ups.
Agency coordination: Support daily communication with social media and influencer marketing agencies, following up on pending deliverables, timelines, feedback and approvals.
Content reviews & approvals: Help review creative assets, captions, influencer scripts and publications to ensure consistency with brand guidelines, product messaging and approved communication.
Campaign execution & tracking: Maintain updated calendars, trackers and status reports for social media and influencer campaigns, ensuring deadlines and deliverables are met.
Performance monitoring & reporting: Collect and organize key metrics such as reach, impressions, engagement, views and follower growth; support the preparation of weekly and monthly performance reports.
Social listening & trend monitoring: Identify relevant social media trends, viral formats, competitor activities and content opportunities that could inspire new ideas and improve engagement.
Community management support: Assist in monitoring comments, mentions and audience interactions, identifying relevant insights and escalating questions or potential issues to the appropriate teams.
Administrative & operational support: Help organize campaign documentation, influencer databases, presentations, budget trackers and other administrative tasks related to marketing initiatives.
Cross-functional collaboration: Work closely with Brand, Product, Design Hub, Operations, Legal, Procurement and other internal teams to support campaign execution and alignment.



We're eager to be in touch because you have...

Must-have requirements


Currently pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Advertising, Digital Media, Business or a related field.
Strong interest in social media, influencer marketing, digital content and emerging trends.
Familiarity with Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube, including content formats, trends and platform dynamics.
Basic knowledge of Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint or Google Workspace (Sheets, Slides and Drive).
Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
Good written and verbal communication skills.
Proactive attitude, creativity, willingness to learn and ability to work collaboratively.
Fluent Spanish and high-intermediate English.
Availability to work part-time according to the internship program requirements.



Nice-to-have skills


Previous internship experience or academic projects related to social media, content creation, digital marketing or influencer campaigns.
Familiarity with social media metrics such as engagement rate, reach, impressions and follower growth.
Basic knowledge of Canva, CapCut or other content editing tools.
Experience creating content for TikTok, Instagram Reels or other social media platforms.
Interest in fintech, financial services and consumer brands.



You'll love working at DiDi because...

We create user value

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.

We are data-driven

We are strong believers in making informed decisions, that’s why we are data-driven. We can better navigate the business landscape strategically by analyzing valuable metrics.

Win-win Collaboration

Success is a team sport. When we work to help our partners and colleagues win, we win, too. While keeping everyone's best interest at heart, we communicate with candor and execute with excellence in all we do.

We believe in integrity

Integrity is at the very core of our business. We are people who always want to do the right thing. Our intentions are sincere, we speak our minds and listen to each other.

Growth

We always strive to do better. That means venturing beyond our comfort zones, learning from our mistakes, and helping each other grow.

Diversity and Inclusion

Diversity is one of our biggest strengths. Our differences are what make us distinct. We respect each other and believe in equal opportunities for all.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams

At DiDi, we believe that our differences are our biggest source of strength. That’s why we are committed to promoting equal opportunities to all candidates and employees as an Equal Opportunity Employer.

Employment and advancement decisions at DiDi are always made based on the needs of the position and the qualifications of the candidate. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on their gender, age, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, pregnancy/maternity, disability, race, religion and beliefs, or any other status protected by applicable laws wherever we operate.

We are committed to building inclusive and diverse teams, and a workplace that is free from discrimination and harassment, because that’s how we create better products and services, make better decisions and better serve the communities we’re a part of.

title: Academic Partnerships Intern – Digital Marketing & Audience Engagement | Academic Partnerships
description:
Job Description

Bring It

You are a university student who enjoys communication, digital content, and working with people. You bring proficient written and verbal communication skills, attention to detail, and an interest in education and technology. You can create engaging content using Microsoft PowerPoint, Canva, Microsoft 365, and social media platforms. You communicate confidently in English and Spanish, while Portuguese is a plus. You can work from the SAP office in Monterrey, Mexico, at least three days per week.

Build It

You will create emails, newsletters, social posts, presentations, invitations, and internal communications for Academic Partnerships. You will help plan and deliver virtual, hybrid, and in-person events across Latin America and the Caribbean. Your work will include coordinating speakers, registrations, venues, communications, and event logistics. You will engage with universities, educators, students, customers, and SAP teams across multiple countries. You will also maintain contact lists, reports, presentations, and activity records. Your work will help SAP connect education communities with SAP technologies, experts, and learning opportunities.

Belong

You will join a regional team that connects SAP with universities, schools, educators, and students. The team works across countries and cultures to create useful learning experiences and stronger connections between academia and industry. You will gain regional exposure, work with different SAP functions, and build relationships across the educational ecosystem. You will also develop your communication, project coordination, digital marketing, and stakeholder management skills through real projects.

Desarrollo de producto, fabricación, calidad y operaciones industriales.

Summary
Apple is a place where extraordinary people come to do their best work. On the Apple Pay Partner Marketing team, we partner with banks, payment networks, fintechs, and merchants to give more customers an easy, secure, and private way to pay.

We're looking for an experienced Partner Marketing Manager to help accelerate Apple Pay growth across Latin America, one of the fastest-growing digital payments regions in the world.

Description
In this role, you'll lead partner marketing programs that grow Apple Pay adoption and engagement across Latin America, particularly in Brazil and Mexico. You'll work across both partner and consumer marketing, building joint programs with partners and shaping the campaigns and messaging that reach customers directly. You'll bring a deep understanding of local consumer behavior, banking and retail culture, and how payments work in each market across the region. You'll also build trusted relationships and align partners and internal teams around shared goals.

Responsibilities

Develop and lead annual marketing plans with issuers, fintechs, payment networks, and merchant partners across the region
Drive integrated campaigns from strategy through execution, with localized messaging that resonates in each market
Own lifecycle marketing initiatives that increase acquisition, activation, and ongoing engagement
Serve as a trusted marketing partner to country teams while influencing senior partner stakeholders

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If:

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

We’d Love To Hear From You If:

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a Commerce Media Specialist, you will support the execution and optimization of marketing campaigns within the commerce media ecosystem. You will leverage your growing expertise to drive client success through effective campaign management, performance tracking, and collaboration with internal teams.

Client-Centric:

Key Responsibilities:


Build, drive, and optimize successful marketing campaigns within your specialty and channel (Amazon, Walmart, and/or Instacart, etc.) to meet and exceed client goals, measured by campaign performance metrics such as conversion rates and ROI.
Foster rapport with clients through weekly interactions via phone, email, and in-person meetings (as needed), striving for a Client Satisfaction score of 9 or above and Client Retention of 95% or above. 


Product-Led::


Integrate Tinuiti’s product and technology suite into campaign activations, focusing on achieving key client metrics and channel-specific success.
Maintain comprehensive knowledge of relevant commerce media platforms applicable to your book of business, proactively educating clients on program updates and benefits.
Maintain annual certifications for relevant commerce media platforms, ensuring expertise and compliance.


Data & Measurement Data-Driven:


Analyze campaign data to extract actionable insights and support optimization efforts, using analytics tools to track performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
Communicate holistic strategy behind your clients’ KPIs by interpreting trends and leveraging cross-channel data/insights within your purview.


Channel Specific Expertise & The Tinuiti Way:


Proactively assess and diagnose opportunities for improvement, implementing changes to achieve growth, retention, and profitability targets for your clients.
Identify new marketing opportunities and ways to repurpose existing strategies to optimize brand awareness and drive sales volume across commerce media platforms.
Demonstrate thought leadership within your vertical/channel and the broader commerce media landscape, contributing insights internally and externally.


Owner Mindset:


Effectively prioritize and manage time across clients, partner relationships, and internal initiatives, ensuring timely delivery of tasks and objectives.
Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by experimenting with new strategies and tools, measured by the implementation of innovative solutions and client feedback.


Ways of working and values


Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, embrace new tools and AI.
Clients grow, we grow: Lead with precision, innovation, and proof.
Culture of ownership: Act with speed, reduce waste, and own outcomes end‑to‑end.


Professional & Technical Qualifications:


2-3 of experience in commerce media or digital advertising roles with a proven track record of executing successful campaigns with monthly budgets of $20k+
Familiarity with commerce media platforms such as Amazon, Walmart, Criteo, etc.
Familiarity with tools such as Skai, Helium10, and Analytic Index a plus


We operate on a flexible hybrid model, but we love seeing our team! For this role, we ask that you come into our great office in Reforma, CDMX, two days a week. This is an essential part of how we collaborate and connect, so candidates should be comfortable with this regular in-office commitment.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Benefits:

Unlimited PTO: At Tinuiti, we believe you deserve time to rest, recharge, and enjoy life unplugged. When you prioritize time for yourself, you're able to bring your best self to work. That’s why we offer unlimited paid time off, a hybrid work environment, and flexibility to take the time you need, when you need it. On top of that, we provide 16 paid holidays, including multiple long weekends, to ensure you have dedicated time to step away and disconnect. We're proud to offer above-industry standard work-life balance, consistently rated as one of the most loved benefits by Tinuitians year after year.

Healthcare: Major Medical (including dental and vision coverage), Minor Medical, Life Insurance Retirement: We offer a Savings Fund which includes a 10% employer match (10% employee contribution required for participation)

Perks and Wellness: Thankful giving, Equity

Parental Leave: Birthing parents receive 16 weeks of leave with 100% pay, consisting of 12 weeks statutory leave and 4 additional paid weeks through company policy. Non-birthing parents will receive 6 weeks of leave with 100% pay.

Learning and Development: On-demand learning (powered by LinkedIn Learning), mentorship program, leadership and management development programs and resources

The actual duties, responsibilities, and qualifications may vary based on assignment or group. Tinuiti is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin, marital status, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status.

title: Marketing Assistant
skills: Support the email team by preparing campaign content, uploading assets, proofreading, and testing emails before they send.
Support social media by drafting captions, scheduling posts, organizing content calendars, and tracking engagement.
Make routine Shopify updates when requested, such as product information, images, and discount codes.
Help keep product listings accurate across our sales channels.
Write and proofread product and marketing copy, adapting to each brand's voice.
Coordinate with designers, freelancers, and video editors to keep creative requests on schedule.
Support photo shoots, events, and influencer programs remotely by tracking deliverables, organizing assets, and managing sample requests.
Pull regular reports from Shopify, Klaviyo, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and social media platforms, and organize them in spreadsheets.
Track sales by channel, email performance, and ad spend, and flag trends or issues to the Marketing Director.
Maintain campaign calendars and deadlines across our brands.
Keep shared drives, brand assets, and marketing files organized and easy to find.
Track marketing vendor invoices and spending.
Manage swag and sample requests.
Take meeting notes, track action items, and follow up with team members on open tasks.
Handle other marketing support requests across our brands as priorities change.
1 to 2 years of marketing experience with ecommerce, consumer products, or pet industry brands.

Hands-on experience with common ecommerce and marketing tools, such as Shopify, Klaviyo or another email platform, social media platforms, and ad platforms. You do not need to be an expert in all of them, but you should be able to contribute without being trained from the ground up.
Strong spreadsheet skills in Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas and organizing performance data.
Professional written and spoken English, sufficient to collaborate daily with a US-based team.
Strong writing skills and comfort adapting tone across multiple brand voices.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities at once.
Available to work 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Pacific Time.
Hands-on experience with Shopify, such as updating products, collections, and discount codes, and pulling reports.
Hands-on experience with Klaviyo, such as preparing and testing emails, building segments, and pulling performance reports.
Experience with TikTok Shop or Amazon Seller Central.
Basic video editing experience (CapCut, Premiere Rush, or similar).
Experience with influencer or affiliate marketing coordination.
Familiarity with Meta Ads, Google Ads, or social media scheduling tools.
description:
Type of work: Full-time

Location: Remote, based in Latin America. Not open to candidates based in the United States.

Working hours: 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Pacific Time

Reports to: Marketing Director

Experience: 1 to 2 years of marketing experience

Salary: $2,000 USD per month




About the Role

Our company is looking for a Marketing Assistant to provide broad marketing and administrative support across our brands. You will work closely with the Marketing Director and with the specialists who own email, Shopify, social media, paid ads, video, and design.

This role keeps marketing work moving. You will pull reports, prepare content, make routine updates, organize files, and handle administrative tasks so the specialists can focus on their own areas. It is a good fit for someone with broad marketing experience who is comfortable stepping in wherever our brands need support.

This role works remotely with a team based primarily in the United States.




What You'll Do

Marketing Support

Support the email team by preparing campaign content, uploading assets, proofreading, and testing emails before they send.
Support social media by drafting captions, scheduling posts, organizing content calendars, and tracking engagement.
Make routine Shopify updates when requested, such as product information, images, and discount codes.
Help keep product listings accurate across our sales channels.
Write and proofread product and marketing copy, adapting to each brand's voice.
Coordinate with designers, freelancers, and video editors to keep creative requests on schedule.
Support photo shoots, events, and influencer programs remotely by tracking deliverables, organizing assets, and managing sample requests.

Reporting

Pull regular reports from Shopify, Klaviyo, Google Ads, Meta Ads, and social media platforms, and organize them in spreadsheets.
Track sales by channel, email performance, and ad spend, and flag trends or issues to the Marketing Director.
Maintain campaign calendars and deadlines across our brands.

Administrative Support

Keep shared drives, brand assets, and marketing files organized and easy to find.
Track marketing vendor invoices and spending.
Manage swag and sample requests.
Take meeting notes, track action items, and follow up with team members on open tasks.
Handle other marketing support requests across our brands as priorities change.




What You Bring

1 to 2 years of marketing experience with ecommerce, consumer products, or pet industry brands.
Hands-on experience with common ecommerce and marketing tools, such as Shopify, Klaviyo or another email platform, social media platforms, and ad platforms. You do not need to be an expert in all of them, but you should be able to contribute without being trained from the ground up.
Strong spreadsheet skills in Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas and organizing performance data.
Professional written and spoken English, sufficient to collaborate daily with a US-based team.
Strong writing skills and comfort adapting tone across multiple brand voices.
Highly organized, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple priorities at once.
Available to work 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Pacific Time.




Nice to Have

Hands-on experience with Shopify, such as updating products, collections, and discount codes, and pulling reports.
Hands-on experience with Klaviyo, such as preparing and testing emails, building segments, and pulling performance reports.
Experience with TikTok Shop or Amazon Seller Central.
Basic video editing experience (CapCut, Premiere Rush, or similar).
Experience with influencer or affiliate marketing coordination.
Familiarity with Meta Ads, Google Ads, or social media scheduling tools.

title: Product Marketing Manager (MX)
skills: Posicionamiento y Narrativa Enterprise: Liderar el posicionamiento y messaging para el segmento enterprise, adaptando la narrativa para audiencias técnicas, comerciales y ejecutivas.

Inteligencia Competitiva y Uso de IA: Crear y mantener el programa de inteligencia competitiva (battlecards, análisis win/loss) usando herramientas de IA/LLMs para automatizar investigaciones de mercado e identificar tendencias.
Sales Enablement: Desarrollar materiales para el equipo comercial (presentaciones, one-pagers, modelos de ROI, documentos técnicos y de seguridad) apoyándote en IA para acelerar la producción.
Voz del Cliente y Colaboración con Producto: Convertir objeciones, patrones de compra y brechas de producto en recomendaciones concretas para influir en las prioridades del roadmap.

Contenido Enterprise y Pricing/Packaging: Liderar la creación de casos de éxito, whitepapers y guías de soluciones, apoyando decisiones de pricing/packaging mediante investigación de mercado y benchmarking.
Definir la narrativa de diferenciación frente a plataformas de IA conversacional, automatización, mensajería y desarrollos internos.
Sintetizar señales de compradores enterprise a partir de investigación asistida por IA.
Trabajar mano a mano con Sales e Ingeniería de Soluciones para capturar objeciones sin generar cuellos de botella.
Medir y optimizar la adopción de materiales de sales enablement y la tasa de cierre (win rate) en cuentas enterprise.
Más de 5 años de experiencia en Product Marketing con enfoque en tecnología enterprise o B2B SaaS.
Experiencia comprobada en sales enablement, inteligencia competitiva o estrategias go-to-market para enterprise en startups de alto crecimiento.
Dominio conceptual de agentes de IA, integraciones, APIs, flujos de trabajo y modelos de lenguaje, con capacidad de traducir capacidades técnicas a valor de negocio demostrable.
Uso habitual y comprobable de herramientas de IA (Claude, ChatGPT u otras) para análisis competitivo y automatización de investigación (más allá de redacción de texto).
Nivel profesional de español e inglés (oral y escrito).
Experiencia previa en mensajería conversacional, WhatsApp Business API, CPaaS o chatbots.
Participación previa en decisiones de pricing y packaging respaldadas por investigación propia.
Formación o cercanía funcional con equipos de ingeniería.
Incrementar el win rate en oportunidades enterprise influenciadas por materiales de enablement.
Reducir el tiempo de producción de battlecards y materiales comerciales mediante flujos asistidos por IA.
Aumentar la adopción de materiales de enablement por el equipo de Account Executives y reducir la duración del ciclo de ventas enterprise.
We Challenge the Norm: Desafiamos lo establecido, cuestionamos con datos e insights y probamos rápido con experimentos.
Evolve or Die: Nos adaptamos con rapidez al entorno, ejecutamos con agilidad sin parálisis por análisis y resolvemos con persistencia.
Act, Own It, Make It Happen: Nos remangamos las mangas, actuamos como dueños (accountability), nos enfocamos en objetivos y aprendemos de forma autónoma.
Stay Playful: Nos reímos, nos ayudamos y celebramos juntos sin tomarnos demasiado en serio.
Rebels with a Cause: Eliminamos la fricción del día a día para generar un impacto tangible en quienes nos rodean.
description:
Sobre Jelou




En Jelou construimos agentes de IA que ejecutan operaciones transaccionales en canales conversacionales. Al traer pagos, verificación de identidad, flujos de crédito y firmas electrónicas directamente a WhatsApp, habilitamos a bancos, fintechs, retailers y empresas en América Latina para ejecutar transacciones generadoras de ingresos sin salir del chat, de forma segura, local y a escala.  




Solo en el último año, las AI Apps construidas sobre nuestra infraestructura procesaron más de USD 100 millones en transacciones financieras.




El Rol




Como Product Marketing Manager, Enterprise, serás el arquitecto de cómo Jelou se posiciona y gana en el segmento enterprise. Definirás la narrativa competitiva y convertirás conversaciones técnicas complejas sobre agentes de IA en argumentos de negocio que el equipo comercial usará para acelerar y cerrar oportunidades.

Responsabilidades clave

Definir la narrativa de diferenciación frente a plataformas de IA conversacional, automatización, mensajería y desarrollos internos.

Medir y optimizar la adopción de materiales de sales enablement y la tasa de cierre (win rate) en cuentas enterprise.

Más de 5 años de experiencia en Product Marketing con enfoque en tecnología enterprise o B2B SaaS.  
Experiencia comprobada en sales enablement, inteligencia competitiva o estrategias go-to-market para enterprise en startups de alto crecimiento.  
Dominio conceptual de agentes de IA, integraciones, APIs, flujos de trabajo y modelos de lenguaje, con capacidad de traducir capacidades técnicas a valor de negocio demostrable.

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

About The Role

We are seeking a data-driven, highly organized Marketplace Operations & Experimentation Specialist to join our Marketplace team and report to the Product Manager for Marketplace. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

The Marketplace is where shoppers discover stores, products, and deals inside the Sezzle app. Our team runs a lot of features, and there's almost always something being tested. You'll be the person who knows what's live, who it's live for, and how it's performing.

This is an operations role with a strong product and data lens. You'll launch and track A/B tests, keep an eye on our shopping partners, and turn results into clear recommendations on what we do next. You'll work closely with product, engineering, data, design, and partnerships. If you like running a lot of experiments at once and keeping every one of them organized, this role is for you.

The salary range for this role is $2,000 - $2,666 per month (Gross in USD)

Experimentation


Set up, QA, and launch A/B tests across Marketplace features. Make sure targeting, variants, and tracking are right before anything goes live.

Keep a single source of truth for every test: what's live, who sees it, and what we learned.

Document test plans, results, and processes, and find parts of the workflow that can be automated with AI.


Required

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.

Clear written and verbal communication in English, with teammates across the business and external partners.
Strong analytical skills. Comfortable with SQL and dashboards, and able to read A/B test results (lift, significance, sample size).
Comfortable in a fast-changing environment where priorities shift.
Detail-oriented with a QA mindset. You catch the targeting mistake before it launches. 
Daily user of Claude or a similar AI tool. You use it to analyze data, write queries, draft docs, and automate repetitive work, and you can walk us through real examples.

Experience with A/B testing or feature flag tools, such as Optimizely, LaunchDarkly, Statsig, or Firebase.
Experience with affiliate, cashback, or advertising partnerships.

You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.

description:
About The Team

Studio Z, Zillow's in-house creative agency, is seeking a versatile writer and strategist to expand our Content team's capabilities. We develop engaging content that helps consumers and real estate professionals achieve their goals — from in-depth articles to snappy email copy to video scripts and social posts. We embody the Zillow core values of transparency, integrity, and putting customers first. To thrive here, you'll also need a good dose of empathy and a sense of humor.

About The Role

This role will craft accurate, compelling content across a wide range of formats: longform articles, shortform web and email copy, and video scripts — both short product showcase videos and longer educational pieces. You'll serve as a thought partner to your Marketing colleagues, helping shape how content can best support our audiences and business goals. Then, working with designers and other creatives, you'll bring your ideas to life as polished, brand-aligned assets. Whatever the format, your sharp, thoughtful writing will inform, engage, and inspire our audiences to work with Zillow.

Because this role is based in Mexico and serves a US-based audience, it requires exceptional English writing and speaking ability — the kind that comes naturally and produces polished, publication-ready copy without heavy editing. Native or near-native fluency is required.

You'll get to:


Work across a wide range of content formats — articles, emails, social posts, web copy, and video scripts — to tell stories that resonate with Zillow's consumer and professional audiences. 
Partner with Marketing colleagues to understand strategic goals and advise on how content can best support them. 
Go deep into content creation, collaborating with a versatile Studio team to produce high-quality pieces at a range of lengths and formats. 
Build understanding and empathy for the challenges facing Americans who are looking to buy, sell, and rent homes in a complex market — and for the hard-working industry professionals who support them. 
Draw on internal research, expert interviews, and external sources to bring stories to life. 


This role has been categorized as a teleworker position. Teleworkers do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and instead work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. Employees may live anywhere in Mexico, with availability to travel to Mexico City, as we recommend attendance at occasional office events.

In addition to a competitive base salary and benefits, this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location.

Who you are

Who you are:


A versatile content creator who can move fluidly between longform editorial, tight email and web copy, and engaging video scripts. 
A curious, diligent writer who can learn the nuances of Zillow's products and services and distill them into clear, compelling stories. 
A strategic problem solver who understands content performance metrics and insights, and use them to optimize your work and communicate its value. 
A meticulous editor who can serve as the last set of eyes on a piece before it’s published. 
A kind, fun colleague who enjoys collaborating with other creatives and learning new things while making work we can all be proud of.. 


Qualifications:


Minimum of 5 years of related experience; or an advanced degree without experience; or equivalent work experience. 
Native or near-native English fluency required. This role demands a true command of written and spoken English — candidates should be exceptional writers who can produce polished, publication-ready content across formats without heavy editing support. 
Demonstrated expertise creating content across multiple formats (articles, email copy, video scripts, web copy, etc.). 
Ability to produce high-quality work efficiently and adapt quickly to shifting priorities. 
Real estate knowledge is a plus but not required. 


We will consider candidates of all backgrounds who bring experience with the core duties and an eagerness to help our audiences succeed.

While this is a remote role, it will require some travel for in-person gatherings and work sessions.

To apply, please submit an application with your resume and a portfolio of copywriting work samples. Applications without work samples will not be considered.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help people navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

How we work is a key part of that transformation. Through Cloud HQ, our strategic approach to distributed work, most employees have the flexibility to work from wherever they’re most productive—enabling us to move fast, stay connected and deliver on our people promise.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2026, and included on TIME’s America’s Best Companies 2026 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment and to providing equal employment opportunities. We comply with applicable laws that prohibit discrimination in employment and recruitment.

If you have a disability or special need that requires reasonable accommodation during the recruitment process, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants will be considered for employment based on their qualifications and ability to perform the functions of the position, without discrimination and in accordance with applicable law.

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Responsabilidades Principales




Estrategia y Planificación: Desarrollar y ejecutar un calendario de contenidos mensual alineado con los objetivos de la marca para plataformas como Instagram, TikTok, LinkedIn, Facebook o X (Twitter).
Creación de Contenido: Redactar copys atractivos y coordinar (o diseñar) elementos visuales (imágenes, infografías, Reels, TikToks).
Gestión de la Comunidad: Interactuar de manera proactiva con la audiencia, respondiendo comentarios y mensajes directos, y fomentando la conversación.
Monitoreo y Análisis: Analizar las métricas de rendimiento (alcance, engagement, conversión) y elaborar reportes periódicos para ajustar y mejorar la estrategia.
Caza de Tendencias: Mantenerse al día con los audios en tendencia, formatos virales y actualizaciones de los algoritmos para adaptar el contenido de manera ágil.
Fotografía: tomar fotografías y videos en lugares hermosos de la ciudad para elaborar contenido, algunas entrevistas (se pagan pasajes y en ocasiones si es algún restaurante un menú básico de la carta).




Requisitos y Experiencia

Conocimiento práctico de herramientas de diseño y edición de video y audio en smartphone o PC.

Deseable (Puntos Extra)

Conocimientos básicos en fotografía y grabación de video con smartphone.




¿Qué ofrecemos?




Salario: Mínimo

Horario: Flexible (Por proyecto)




Sobre el puesto




El trabajo es remoto y por objetivos, sin un horario fijo. Tu función principal será la edición de video y la grabación de tomas para proyectos con guiones previamente escritos. Las fechas de entrega se pactarán de mutuo acuerdo, lo que te dará total libertad para manejar tus tiempos o incluso combinar este proyecto con otros trabajos o estudios.




¿Qué harás? El objetivo central es posicionar contenido en redes sociales (Instagram, Facebook y TikTok). Trabajarás en dos líneas de contenido:

Videos con IA: Edición de material basado en guiones con personajes de Inteligencia Artificial.
Contenido realista en exteriores: Grabación de tomas fotográficas, videos de apoyo y breves entrevistas en diversas locaciones (restaurantes, museos, parques, plazas comerciales, etc.). Toda grabación se realizará siempre con el permiso previo de los encargados del lugar.

¿Para quién es ideal? La carga de trabajo es ligera y el sueldo sinceramente es modesto (proporcional al tiempo invertido). Por ello, esta oportunidad está pensada principalmente para:

Jóvenes que buscan ganar experiencia y dar sus primeros pasos en el mundo audiovisual.
Personas de cualquier edad que disfruten la creación de contenido y deseen tomarlo como un hobby o un ingreso extra sin presiones.

Si buscas un proyecto relajado, con completa flexibilidad y espacio para explorar tu creatividad, ¡me encantaría platicar contigo!

title: Social Media Manager
skills: Lead the team and own the system. Lead a team of social media specialists on scaled social video production, own the process from channel ideation and talent acquisition through publishing and measurement, and build systems that keep creators and internal teams aligned and expert in the Study.com brand.
Champion AI. Build an AI assisted workflow for the team to conduct trend tracking and research at every stage, while keeping content credible, authentic and community-driven.
Bring best practices and drive experimentation. Bring industry best practices, run experimentation roadmaps with the team, and share wins, losses and insights across channels.
Source great talent. Create a sourcing approach to identify platform-native creators, customers, partners and UGC talent, and own outreach, negotiation and agreements to build a deep bench.

Collaborate with and support creators. Work hands-on with talent on storytelling and channel fit, and equip them with the Study.com knowledge and branding they need, without writing their voice for them.
Spot trends and opportunities. Know your niches, move fast on trends, and turn insights into the next round of ideas.
Make every piece platform-native. Ensure content is tailored to the algorithms and user preferences and trends in each platform.
Manage production. Keep talent, content, publishing and production bundles on schedule, on target, and within budget.
Foster community. Build engaged communities on our channels and help creators grow theirs.
Measure and report. Own a revenue goal for your channels, supported by social KPIs and business metrics like conversions and self-reported revenue, and share insights that shape what's next.
5+ years in social media, creator partnerships or talent management, with at least 2 managing creators directly and negotiating partnerships
Deep, current fluency in TikTok, Instagram Reels and YouTube (long-form and Shorts).
Strong creative judgment on hooks, storytelling and edits, with the restraint to let creators keep their voice.
A track record of sourcing, negotiating with and growing creators.
Experience leading social media production and social media experts.
Strong analytical skills. Comfort tying social performance to revenue and conversion, not just views.
Experience with AI tools for research, trend tracking, content product and workflows.
Experience building a UGC or customer-to-creator program.
SEO and Search literacy. Including keyword research, metadata, and knowledge on how video shows up in search and AI-generated answers.
description:
The Social Media Manager is responsible for managing content production on our owned channels, and partnering with creators to grow Study.com’s presence across social platforms. This person brings expertise in content strategy, with knowledge of social-native formats and best practices on each platform. This person knows how to work with and find great creators, provide excellent creative direction, and lead content creation to drive measurable growth for Study.com across TikTok, Instagram and YouTube. At its core, this role is about finding authentic voices and helping them tell their stories well through our customer voices, creators using the platform, and our school and brand partners.




Internally, you'll work with a team of social media specialists across a portfolio of college- and career-focused channels on YouTube, TikTok and Instagram. On the talent side, you'll negotiate both short-term and long-term agreements with creators and partners, and make sure we hit our production goals and targets.

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

Our Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. This position requires travel up to 30% of the time.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will: 

Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value
Orchestrate renewal-focused business reviews with our customers where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals
Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more
Mitigate escalations and resolve customer issues
Help Customers with a wide range of general inquiries and questions
Solve customer issues and escalations about Samsara products and services
Experience in multi-channel servicing including excellent phone skills and good writing skills for Web, email, and channel requests
Ability to prioritize work queue and backlog in addition to incoming customer requests
Provide excellent customer service throughout the service cycle from initial request to final close out of the transaction
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

2-5 years of experience in a Customer Success, account management, or consulting role. SaaS experience preferred
Experience supporting or working with technical products
Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
Spanish and English fluency
IA tools fluency (Claude/ Pilot/ Gemini, others)

An ideal candidate also has:

Has strong bias for standardization & automation, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
Thrives in a fast-paced and change-heavy environment
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

At Stripe, our Mexico City office is a vibrant hub at the forefront of our mission to reshape the financial landscape for businesses worldwide. Our team prioritizes collaboration, innovation, and excellence. As a member of the Mexico City team, you'll be part of a mission-driven community dedicated to enhancing the global economy and increasing the GDP of the internet. We strive for excellence by creating with craft and beauty, while having fun and celebrating our successes together.

We cultivate a culture of collaboration, inclusivity and support where every team member’s voice matters. Our commitment shines through as we handle over a million support cases each year, empowering our users not just to solve problems but to achieve their goals.

What you’ll do

Responsibilities


Troubleshoot and solve external user issues
Communicate resolutions to end users in English
Analyze our processes and instigate changes to help scale our operations and improve user experience
Work closely with other Stripe teams to improve our product offerings and messaging around new products and features
Gain unique insights into how thousands of businesses on Stripe scale and operate
Have an opportunity to learn how Stripe operates from ground up and make a real impact on the future organization
Be a part of building a brand new team and operational culture for Stripe
Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to run a critical workflow



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


You have a user first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems
You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbal
You have business proficiency in written and spoken English
You excel in analytical thinking and problem solving
You might have prior experience in customer service or internal/external user facing operations
You enjoy learning about technical products and processes, you are an organized, self-starter with passion for finding solutions to user’s challenges
You have a process-oriented mindset and ability to get things done
You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross team collaboration and support
You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a quick-moving environment
You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners
You're willing to periodically work a weekend day for which you will receive a weekday off; the SDC operates during daytime hours with shifts from the morning through early evening



Preferred Qualifications


Prior experience or knowledge in user support
Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives
Familiarity with SQL and ability to use template or premade SQL queries as part of investigations



Applicants are personally responsible for obtaining and maintaining the right to work in Mexico.

In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

Job Description

Visa’s Internship Program provides an immersive, 12-month journey where you’ll work on impactful projects that drive Visa’s mission forward. As a Visa intern, you’ll build valuable connections across the organization, sharpen your communication and business acumen, and gain hands-on experience in a dynamic, global environment.

Throughout the program, you’ll have exclusive access to interactive workshops and learning sessions designed to deepen your expertise, expand your industry knowledge, and elevate your professional skillset. You won’t just be learning, you’ll be contributing, collaborating, and innovating every step of the way.

The experience culminates in an exciting final presentation, where you’ll showcase your project achievements, share key insights, and present your recommendations to Visa’s leaders and stakeholders. This is your chance to demonstrate your business impact, highlight your personal growth, and align your work with Visa’s vision for the future.

Client Services

As a Client Services Intern, you will contribute to one of Visa's dynamic technology teams, gaining exposure to client engagement and operations. You will have the opportunity to take on responsibilities that broaden your skills, acquire new knowledge, and explore different areas of our business, all while supporting initiatives that enhance client success and performance.

All Visa roles require digital fluency, including the ability to work with emerging technologies such as Generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot) to support everyday work.

Operational value generation and performance improvement: Support monitoring related to new client onboarding, implementations, and issue resolution

Revenue flow monitoring: Partner with the Sr. Client Success Manager to track revenue pipeline health and execution across Client Services, VCA, and optimization flows
Strategic initiative tracking: Support monitoring of key Mexico strategic initiatives across cross-border, acceptance, and affluent segments
Stakeholder visibility and roadblock management: Collaborate with the Sr. Client Success Manager to track initiative development and progress, ensuring executive stakeholders are informed of milestones and any direction adjustments required to stay on track


Remember, at Visa, we see our employees as our most valuable asset, and we are excited to support and witness your growth within our organization.

Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications


Understanding of project management principles and practices 
Familiarity with analytics and process improvement methods 
Foundational skills in data analysis, including collection, organization, interpretation, and presentation 
English proficiency (written and spoken) 
Currently enrolled in a degree program related to engineering, business, data science, or a similar field; expected graduation between November 2027 and March 2028


Preferred Qualifications


Clear, structured communication skills in both written and verbal formats 
Ability to learn quickly, collaborate effectively, and approach challenges with a problem-solving mindset 
Strong interpersonal skills and team orientation 
Comfort navigating ambiguity and adapting to changing priorities 
Analytical thinking and attention to detail


Additional Information

INTERN ONLY: Work Authorization: Visa will not sponsor applicants for work visas in connection with this position. Future sponsorship will not be considered.

Work Hours: Varies upon the needs of the department and student’s availability. During off season 8:30-5PM schedule is expected, during school calendar year we can define given student’s study hours validation

This is a hybrid position. Expectation of 3 days in office Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday.

Mental/Physical Requirements: This position will be performed in an office setting.  The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as computers.

description:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

 

About the role:

Our Customer Success Managers pick up where our Implementation team leaves off, working closely with our customers to understand their fleet and unique challenges, advising on how to customize Samsara for their needs, and becoming their long-term partner.

Your role will be cross-functional in nature, working alongside and connecting Sales, Support, Sales Engineering and Product, enabling you to experience multiple aspects of a hyper-growth company from within.

This is a remote position open to candidates residing in Mexico. Relocation assistance will not be provided for this role. This position requires travel up to 30% of the time.

You should apply if:

You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will: 

Be on the front-lines and ensure our customers increase the safety, efficiency, and sustainability of their operations with our IoT platform
Compose joint success plans with customers, outlining their objectives, metrics, timelines, and effectively removing any barriers to achieving business value
Orchestrate renewal-focused business reviews with our customers where we look back at past successes and align on upcoming goals
Deeply understand the Samsara platform’s capabilities and explain them to businesses of all types - field services, utilities, long-haul transportation, school buses, and many more
Mitigate escalations and resolve customer issues
Help Customers with a wide range of general inquiries and questions
Solve customer issues and escalations about Samsara products and services
Experience in multi-channel servicing including excellent phone skills and good writing skills for Web, email, and channel requests
Ability to prioritize work queue and backlog in addition to incoming customer requests
Provide excellent customer service throughout the service cycle from initial request to final close out of the transaction
Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

Minimum requirements for the role:

2-5 years of experience in a Customer Success, account management, or consulting role. SaaS experience preferred
Experience supporting or working with technical products
Solutions-oriented with strong problem-solving skills
Passion for going above and beyond the call of duty, taking initiative, and thriving in a fast-paced, change-heavy environment
Bachelor’s degree from a 4-year institution
Spanish and English fluency
IA tools fluency (Claude/ Pilot/ Gemini, others)

An ideal candidate also has:

Has strong bias for standardization & automation, the ability to think big, with insistence on high standards
Thrives in a fast-paced and change-heavy environment
 

Total Rewards

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

Flexible Working 

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

Belonging at Samsara

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

Accommodations 

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

Our Commitment to Authenticity

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

Fraudulent Employment Offers

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

Schedule: Full-time, aligned with Eastern Time business hours

Compensation: C$42,000–C$48,000 annually, based on experience and qualifications

The Opportunity

We are recruiting for an established Canadian residential real estate services company that manages relationships between property owners, residents, internal teams, and external service partners.

We are looking for a Customer Service Manager to directly manage a team of client-facing employees. You will be accountable for their workload, responsiveness, service quality, documentation, performance, and client-retention results.

This is a formal people-management position with direct reports—not a senior customer-service or individual-contributor role. Direct property-management experience is preferred but not mandatory. Strong managers from other recurring-service industries will be considered.

Key Responsibilities


Directly manage, coach, and evaluate client-facing employees.
Assign workloads and ensure employees understand their priorities and deadlines.
Conduct regular one-on-one meetings, coaching, and performance reviews.
Investigate missed commitments, repeated complaints, poor-quality work, and incomplete documentation.
Create performance-improvement plans and recommend reassignment or replacement when improvement does not occur.
Ensure customer onboarding, scheduled check-ins, and follow-ups are completed.
Identify dissatisfied or at-risk clients and lead service-recovery efforts.
Monitor contract renewals and client-retention activities.
Oversee escalated concerns, overdue payments, and compliance-sensitive matters.
Coordinate service requests across internal departments and external partners.
Hold employees and service partners accountable for their commitments.
Ensure employees follow company systems, documentation standards, and escalation procedures.
Evaluate whether performance problems are caused by workload, process, training, or individual performance.
Produce reports identifying client risks, overdue work, team performance, and required action.
Improve workflows, service standards, reporting, and departmental accountability.


Required Experience


Four or more years in customer experience, customer success, service delivery, account management, operations, property management, or another recurring-service environment.
At least two years of formal people-management experience with direct reports in a client-facing or operational department. Informal team leadership alone is not sufficient.
Experience coaching employees, evaluating performance, and addressing underperformance.
Experience handling escalations, service failures, renewals, and client-retention risks.
Experience assigning work, monitoring deadlines, and holding employees accountable.
Experience coordinating across departments, vendors, or external partners.
Experience using KPIs, dashboards, CRM, ticketing, or workflow-management systems.
Excellent written and spoken English.
Strong organization, judgment, prioritization, and follow-through.
Ability to be assertive and direct while remaining calm and professional.
Ability to work independently during Eastern Time business hours.
Reliable internet, backup connectivity or power, and a professional environment for calls.


Candidates may come from customer success, managed services, BPO, SaaS, telecommunications, insurance, financial services, property management, hospitality, facilities, field services, healthcare, logistics, or another high-volume service industry.

Property-management or North American client experience is an asset. Industry-specific training will be provided.

What Success Looks Like

Performance Will Be Measured Through


Team productivity and service quality
Employee responsiveness and accountability
Client retention and contract renewals
Customer onboarding and follow-up completion
Service resolution and escalation management
Documentation quality and system compliance
Reduction of overdue and unresolved work
Accuracy and usefulness of management reporting


Who Will Succeed

The right person is comfortable managing people, not simply completing their work for them.

You must be able to challenge unclear explanations, address missed commitments, set measurable expectations, conduct difficult performance conversations, and apply consequences when improvement does not occur.

You should also know when to support an employee, when additional training is needed, and when continued underperformance requires reassignment or replacement.

How to Apply

Apply with your resume. If your background aligns with the position, you’ll receive an email with a link to complete a short pre-recorded video interview within 24–48 hours of applying.

Medical marketing, Global Medical Affairs, Stakeholder relationship management; Customer relationship management, Key account management; strategic partnership, Customer value maximisation, Influencing, Storytelling, Negotiation skills, operational excellence, Compliance monitoring, Digital activation to HCPs, Digital strategy; Channel strategy, Medical Sales; Clinical sales knowledge, Medical Marketing, Capability building.
