description:
Who We Are

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If

Research shows that while men apply to jobs when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women and other marginalized folks tend to only apply when they check every box. So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

As a Paid Social Senior Specialist, you will build, launch, and improve Paid Social campaigns (Meta, TikTok, Pinterest Performance+, Snapchat, Reddit) to grow new customers, revenue, and LTV while keeping efficiency on track. You’ll follow clear playbooks, turn performance data and creative learnings into next actions, and pilot practical innovations at a small scale before wider rollout. You’ll work closely with Creative, Analytics, Product/Bliss Point, and senior channel leads in your Pod, communicate clearly with clients, and document what works so the team can reuse it. We align scope and expectations to our job architecture for consistency and transparent progression.

Key Responsibilities

Client‑Centric


Prepare on‑time, accurate updates and contribute to QBR inputs; explain results and recommended next steps in plain language tied to goals.
Take action on client requests (e.g., promo changes, budgets) within guardrails and escalate when trade‑offs are needed.


The Tinuiti Way


Own day-to-day campaign management across Paid Social (Meta, TikTok, etc)
Apply strong Paid Social craft aligned with the Tinuiti Way (creative + audience + signal quality) with growing multi‑channel awareness; share simple “how‑to” guides and playbacks for repeatability.


Product‑Led


Operate platform features (Meta Advantage+/value optimization/CAPI, TikTok Smart Performance, Pinterest Performance+); run small, safe pilots and monitor outcomes before scaling.
Use Bliss Point signals (e.g., Forecasting, Always‑On Incrementality, Creative Insights) shared by the team to guide day‑to‑day optimizations; log issues and feedback for Product/Analytics.


Data & Measurement‑Driven


Monitor performance daily/weekly; run basic A/Bs with predefined success criteria and simple read cadence; keep pacing and budgets healthy.
Maintain signal and data quality (pixel/CAPI basics, event checks, UTMs/GA4 alignment) using checklists; partner with Analytics to validate reads and resolve anomalies.


Owner Mindset


Manage a clear work queue and deliver on time; proactively reduce rework and non‑converting spend (e.g., creative fatigue, audience overlap, “learning limited”); close the loop with documented learnings.


Ways of working and values


Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, embrace new tools and AI.
Clients grow, we grow: Focus on outcomes, evidence, and simple explanations.
Culture of ownership: Move fast, cut waste, and own the result end‑to‑end.


Professional & Technical Qualifications


3-5+ years running Paid Social with hands‑on builds, launches, pacing, and optimizations; strong experience on Meta and TikTok.
Confidence planning and executing across Meta, TikTok, Pinterest Performance+, Snapchat, and Reddit; familiarity with LinkedIn and X is a plus.
Comfortable with GA4 and platform analytics; can turn data into clear next steps and basic forecasts.
Communication and collaboration: Clear client‑facing updates; cross‑functional teamwork; ability to mentor and delegate work to more junior team members.
Advanced Excel/Sheets and presentation tool skills


KPIs 


Growth: Increase qualified reach and new‑customer acquisition; contribute to revenue and LTV growth from Paid Social.
Creative: Faster creative innovation cycles and higher win rate; reduced fatigue.
Audience and signal: Expand high‑intent audiences; improve pixel/CAPI/event health; fewer “limited learning” cases.
Innovation: Deliver a steady flow of practical innovations (creative, audience, bidding, format) and record decisions and learnings.
Product/AI adoption: Pilot and adopt platform automation and Bliss Point‑guided optimizations with proven, incremental impact.
Efficiency (guardrail): Maintain or improve CAC/ROAS while growing profitable volume.

skills: Own paid video for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.
Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform’s specs and native feel.
Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets.

Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn’t. Keep your tooling current as the models change, and build repeatable workflows the rest of the team can reuse.

Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, including experimental ones alongside BAU work, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.

Version and localize video at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you’ll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.

Flex into AI-assisted paid static when a campaign calls for it, working from the team’s brand baselines.
Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.

5+ years in performance video creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.

A portfolio submitted with your application. Paid video above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you’re able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.
Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.
High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.
Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. Establecer estrategias de price floors para proteger el valor del inventario y la marca.
Mantener controles de calidad sobre etiquetas, formatos y entrega de campañas.

Analizar discrepancias, errores de medición, caídas de tráfico e incidencias de facturación.
Auditar configuraciones, etiquetas, registros de plataforma y cambios recientes en sitios o aplicaciones.
Coordinar la resolución de incidentes con Desarrollo, Producto, Infraestructura, Comercial y Finanzas.
Asegurar cierres de facturación precisos y oportunos.

Proteger a las marcas anunciantes y a las propiedades de la compañía frente a fraude, anuncios no válidos y ubicaciones inadecuadas.

Traducir las necesidades de clientes, agencias y equipos comerciales en especificaciones técnicas accionables.
Guiar a desarrolladores y Scrum Masters en la correcta implementación de ad tags y cambios de monetización.

Presentar resultados, riesgos y oportunidades de ingresos a la dirección corporativa.
Experiencia senior en AdOps, monetización programática, yield management o estrategia Supply-Side.
Experiencia práctica y profunda con Google Ad Manager, idealmente GAM 360.
Experiencia integrando o gestionando Header Bidding, Prebid.js y múltiples SSPs.
Experiencia en monetización de video y/o audio digital; se valorará especialmente SSAI y streaming.
Conocimiento práctico de protocolos y etiquetas publicitarias, incluidos VAST y DAAST.
Experiencia investigando discrepancias de medición entre ad servers, agencias y anunciantes.
Conocimiento de herramientas de verificación y brand safety, como MOAT, IAS o DoubleVerify.
Capacidad para leer e interpretar HTML5, JavaScript y JSON y colaborar con equipos de desarrollo en implementaciones técnicas.
Habilidad para analizar métricas de rendimiento y relacionarlas con ingresos, rentabilidad y disponibilidad de inventario.
Experiencia liderando proyectos transversales y trabajando con áreas comerciales y técnicas.
Mentalidad de Yield Management: criterio analítico y financiero para optimizar ingresos, precios y fill rate.
Autonomía diagnóstica: capacidad para investigar caídas de rendimiento y encontrar sus causas técnicas u operativas.
Traducción técnico-comercial: habilidad para convertir necesidades comerciales en soluciones e instrucciones claras para los equipos técnicos.
Liderazgo transversal: capacidad para alinear áreas con prioridades diferentes y avanzar proyectos sin depender de una sola función.
Enfoque en audiencia y negocio: búsqueda de ingresos sostenibles que protejan la experiencia del usuario, la marca y la estabilidad de las plataformas.
Crecimiento sostenido del eCPM y del RPM en web, audio y video.
Incremento de los ingresos programáticos y del ingreso total generado por el inventario propio.
Mejora del fill rate del inventario elegible; la meta de referencia es superior al 95%, medida por canal y tipo de demanda.
Reducción de discrepancias entre los sistemas propios y los reportes externos, con una referencia de 3% a 5% o menos, conforme a los criterios de medición acordados.
Menor latencia y menos incidencias que afecten la entrega o reproducción de anuncios.
Mayor precisión en facturación, pronósticos y reportes de monetización.
Implementación exitosa de mejoras en la arquitectura de subastas y streaming.

Foster rapport with clients through weekly interactions via phone, email, and in-person meetings (as needed), striving for a Client Satisfaction score of 9 or above and Client Retention of 95% or above.

Maintain comprehensive knowledge of relevant commerce media platforms applicable to your book of business, proactively educating clients on program updates and benefits.

Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by experimenting with new strategies and tools, measured by the implementation of innovative solutions and client feedback.
Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, embrace new tools and AI.
Clients grow, we grow: Lead with precision, innovation, and proof.
Culture of ownership: Act with speed, reduce waste, and own outcomes end‑to‑end.
2-3 of experience in commerce media or digital advertising roles with a proven track record of executing successful campaigns with monthly budgets of $20k+

Familiarity with tools such as Skai, Helium10, and Analytic Index a plus
description:
Who We Are:

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. Built for marketers who demand growth and accountability, Tinuiti unites media and measurement under one roof to eliminate waste—the biggest growth killer of all—and scale what works. Its proprietary technology, Bliss Point by Tinuiti, reveals the truth around growth and waste, and how to capitalize on it. With expert teams across Commerce, Search, Social, TV & Audio, and more, Tinuiti delivers measurable results with brutal simplicity: Love Growth. Hate Waste.

We’d Love To Hear From You If:

So if you think you qualify, but don't necessarily meet every single point on the job description, please still get in touch.

Tinuiti is the largest independent full-funnel marketing agency in the U.S. across the media that matters most, with $4 billion in digital media under management and more than 1,200 employees. As a Commerce Media Specialist, you will support the execution and optimization of marketing campaigns within the commerce media ecosystem. You will leverage your growing expertise to drive client success through effective campaign management, performance tracking, and collaboration with internal teams.

Client-Centric:

Key Responsibilities:


Build, drive, and optimize successful Walmart DSP marketing campaigns within your specialty and channel to meet and exceed client goals, measured by campaign performance metrics such as conversion rates and ROI.
Foster rapport with clients through weekly interactions via phone, email, and in-person meetings (as needed), striving for a Client Satisfaction score of 9 or above and Client Retention of 95% or above. 


Product-Led::


Integrate Tinuiti’s product and technology suite into campaign activations, focusing on achieving key client metrics and channel-specific success.
Maintain comprehensive knowledge of relevant commerce media platforms applicable to your book of business, proactively educating clients on program updates and benefits.
Maintain annual certifications for relevant commerce media platforms, ensuring expertise and compliance.


Data & Measurement Data-Driven:


Analyze campaign data to extract actionable insights and support optimization efforts, using analytics tools to track performance and identify opportunities for improvement.
Communicate holistic strategy behind your clients’ KPIs by interpreting trends and leveraging cross-channel data/insights within your purview.


Channel Specific Expertise & The Tinuiti Way:


Proactively assess and diagnose opportunities for improvement, implementing changes to achieve growth, retention, and profitability targets for your clients.
Identify new marketing opportunities and ways to repurpose existing strategies to optimize brand awareness and drive sales volume across commerce media platforms.
Demonstrate thought leadership within your vertical/channel and the broader commerce media landscape, contributing insights internally and externally.


Owner Mindset:


Effectively prioritize and manage time across clients, partner relationships, and internal initiatives, ensuring timely delivery of tasks and objectives.
Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by experimenting with new strategies and tools, measured by the implementation of innovative solutions and client feedback.


Ways of working and values


Greatness attracts Greatness: Seek feedback, hone craft, embrace new tools and AI.
Clients grow, we grow: Lead with precision, innovation, and proof.
Culture of ownership: Act with speed, reduce waste, and own outcomes end‑to‑end.


Professional & Technical Qualifications:


2-3 of experience in commerce media or digital advertising roles with a proven track record of executing successful campaigns with monthly budgets of $20k+
Familiarity with commerce media platforms such as Amazon, Walmart, Criteo, etc.
Familiarity with tools such as Skai, Helium10, and Analytic Index a plus


We operate on a flexible hybrid model, but we love seeing our team! For this role, we ask that you come into our great office in Reforma, CDMX, two days a week. This is an essential part of how we collaborate and connect, so candidates should be comfortable with this regular in-office commitment.

Benefits:

Unlimited PTO: At Tinuiti, we believe you deserve time to rest, recharge, and enjoy life unplugged. When you prioritize time for yourself, you're able to bring your best self to work. That’s why we offer unlimited paid time off, a hybrid work environment, and flexibility to take the time you need, when you need it. On top of that, we provide 16 paid holidays, including multiple long weekends, to ensure you have dedicated time to step away and disconnect. We're proud to offer above-industry standard work-life balance, consistently rated as one of the most loved benefits by Tinuitians year after year.

Healthcare: Major Medical (including dental and vision coverage), Minor Medical, Life Insurance Retirement: We offer a Savings Fund which includes a 10% employer match (10% employee contribution required for participation)

Parental Leave: Birthing parents receive 16 weeks of leave with 100% pay, consisting of 12 weeks statutory leave and 4 additional paid weeks through company policy. Non-birthing parents will receive 6 weeks of leave with 100% pay.

Learning and Development: On-demand learning (powered by LinkedIn Learning), mentorship program, leadership and management development programs and resources

The Senior Manager, Luxury Brand Management, is responsible for the disciplined implementation and pull-through of approved Luxury brand strategies, standards, proof points, service culture, programming, and guest experiences across operating hotels and pipeline projects in CALA, while supporting selected CALA Luxury initiatives as assigned.

Implements marketing, digital, trade marketing, and patient education initiatives and defines measurable pilots, resources, timelines, and success criteria.




Required Qualifications

University degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Commercial Management or related field.

description:
About Hilbert

Hilbert is a scalable, data science-first growth engine that gives B2C teams predictive clarity into user behavior, revenue drivers, and the actions that drive sustainable growth. Fully agentic by design, Hilbert shrinks months-long decision cycles to minutes.

From Fortune 10 enterprises to beloved brands like FreshDirect, Blank Street, and Levain Bakery, operators run their growth on Hilbert. We're also co-building alongside leading AI companies.

The problem you are hired to solve

Hilbert's pipeline comes from Executive dinners, advisor firesides at the office, briefings at the customer's offices, side events at conferences. Events and warm introductions produce most of the deals that reach a second meeting.

Today those rooms happen when a founder or a regional sales leader makes them happen. There is no calendar, no owner, no follow-up standard and no count of which room produced which meeting. The Americas pipeline spans the United States, Mexico, Brazil and the Andean markets, and the sellers in each of them are building their own event plans from scratch.

That is this role: own the Americas event programme end to end, decide what goes on it, and measure it on the budget-holder meetings it produces.

What the role is

The Field Marketing Manager owns the strategy and the execution of every in-person and live-audience programme in the Americas. The job has two halves.

The first is the outside calendar: which conferences and industry events Hilbert joins, at what level, and what it does there. You recommend the list with the reasoning, and then you run each one, from the sponsorship decision to the side event, the speaker slots, the meeting schedule and the on-site execution.

The second is the programmes Hilbert hosts itself: executive dinners in the hub cities, advisor and investor firesides and podcast recordings at the office, customer roundtables and webinars. You design the format, the audience and the guest list, propose it, and then produce every part of it, including the promotion and the follow-up that turn attendance into meetings.

You plan both halves with the regional sales leaders, run them yourself, and report what each one produced. You are the first field marketer in the Americas. Your counterpart in EMEA runs the same programme there, and you build the shared playbook together.

What the role is not


Not content production. The founders and the product marketing lead decide what Hilbert says publicly and write the materials. You decide where it is said, to whom, and what happens the next morning.
Not paid acquisition. Hilbert runs no paid demand programmes today and this role does not start one.


The impact you will have


Decide the Americas calendar for the year with the regional sales leaders: which outside events to join, which events to host and in which office cities, which accounts in the room, and what each one has to produce. Recommend it with the reasoning and own it once agreed.
Run the executive dinner series in the hub cities, with guest lists drawn from target accounts and late-stage deals, and a follow-up plan agreed with the sellers before the invitations go out.
Own Hilbert's presence at the conferences you chose, from the sponsorship decision to the side event, the speaker slots, the meeting schedule and the on-site execution.
Design and produce the office programmes: advisor and investor firesides, live-audience podcast recordings, customer roundtables and webinars. You propose the format and the guest, and then you produce the whole thing, from the invitation to the recording to what is published afterwards.
Run pre-event targeting and post-event follow-up with sellers so that attendance becomes meetings within the week, not the quarter.
Manage vendors, venues, budgets and the partners who co-host with Hilbert.
Promote every programme through the channels Hilbert uses, LinkedIn and the newsletter among them, within the review process the company sets for public content.
Track every programme in the CRM: invited, attended, met, advanced. Report it monthly and change the calendar on what the numbers say.
Write the playbook, so that a dinner in Mexico City runs to the same standard as one in New York, and so that the next region can copy it.


How you are measured


Meetings with budget holders at target accounts that trace to a programme you ran.
Late-stage deals that advanced within thirty days of an event their buyer attended.
Cost per qualified meeting, by format.
Programmes delivered on the date and budget agreed.


What we look for


Four or more years in field marketing or event marketing at a B2B technology company with an enterprise sales motion, with end-to-end ownership of programmes from guest list to follow-up.
Has built an event strategy, not only executed one. Can show a calendar they designed, what they chose to join, what they chose to host, what they turned down, and what each produced.
Has run executive dinners and small, senior rooms and can show which meetings and deals came out of them. Has also run a conference presence with speakers, side events and a meeting schedule.
Has designed and produced an owned format from nothing: a dinner series, a podcast, a fireside or a webinar programme that ran more than once because it worked.

Operationally exact. Vendors, venues, budgets, registration, name badges and the follow-up list are all yours, and you keep every one of them on track.
Writes a clear invitation, a clear brief for a speaker and a clear report for a sales leader.
Fluent in English and Spanish. The Americas programme runs in both.
Comfortable at startup pace, with a programme to build, no agency behind you at first, and a founder's calendar to work around.
Able to travel around 30 percent across the United States and Latin America.


Nice to have: Portuguese; experience with HubSpot; a network among CMOs and growth leaders in retail, grocery, QSR or banking; experience at a company that sold to the same buyers Hilbert sells to; experience building a field programme from nothing.

Your first ninety days

Geotab is advancing security, connecting commercial vehicles to the internet and providing web-based analytics to help customers better manage their fleets. Processing billions of data points a day, Geotab leverages data analytics and machine learning to improve productivity, optimize fleets through the reduction of fuel consumption, enhance driver safety and achieve strong compliance to regulatory changes.
Our team is growing and we’re looking for people who follow their passion, think differently and want to make an impact. Ours is a fast paced, ever changing environment. Join us for a fulfilling career with opportunities to innovate, great benefits, and our fun and inclusive work culture. Reach your full potential with Geotab. Who You Are
We are always looking for amazing talent who can contribute to our growth and deliver results! Geotab is seeking a Channel Marketing Manager who will be responsible for channel lifecycle marketing strategy for major market partners. The projects will vary in scope, complexity, and affected business area. If you love technology, and are keen to join an industry leader — we would love to hear from you!

What You'll Do
The Channel Marketing Manager will work with Marketing and Sales leadership to set and achieve business targets, and provide monthly, quarterly and annual marketing performance. This position will be the key point of contact for the partner relationship to support the development of joint channel marketing plans that help deliver against sell-in and sell-through targets.
How you'll make an impact

Driving, and executing joint marketing strategy and go-to-market planning across all aspects of the marketing mix: merchandising, sales tools, training, media publications, digital, events, etc. 
Building and growing marketing relationships to influence partner mindshare for ATL and BTL initiatives. 
Leverage data-driven sales, operations and management strategies to inform and scale marketing campaigns and channel programs. 
Communicate internally the needs of the channel to help influence decision making. 
Identify and develop required marketing assets to support marketing strategy and promote joint offerings. 
Manage annual budgets and reporting against key metrics such as expected and actual outcomes. Track, measure and report marketing program success. 
Lead creative campaign briefing discussions with partner contacts, with ability to drive influence with partner leadership and partner agencies. 
Serve as an expert of both Geotab and partner brands, ensuring all activity delivers joint value outcomes and adheres to all privacy and data protection compliance requirements. 
Facilitate roundtables, customer briefings and other forums to develop customer advocacy and VOC. 

What you'll bring to the role

Minimum of 5+ years managing commercial and marketing relationships with Telecom Wireless Carriers / Fortune 500 accounts. 
Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Commerce, Sales or related field. 
Equivalent combination of education and/or work experience in a related field may be substituted. 
Ability to devise effective channel strategies aligned with overall marketing and business objectives, considering target audience, market trends, and competitive landscape; disciplined strategic planning, execution and analysis of all programs to maximize customer loyalty and optimize promotional strategies; strong critical thinking skills and proven track record leading innovative business improvements in multichannel environments. 
Skill in building and maintaining strong relationships with channel partners to drive mutual growth and achieve sales targets. 
Proficiency in developing comprehensive marketing plans tailored for different channels, including promotions, advertising campaigns, incentives, and sales support materials; demonstrated experience executing on plans driving cross-channel portfolio growth through scalable marketing strategy. 
Deep understanding of the Geotab products or services being marketed, including features, benefits, competitive advantages, and target customer segments. 
Ability to leverage market research, competitive analysis to identify channel opportunities, trends, and potential challenges. 
Skill in analyzing marketing data, such as sales figures, ROI, and channel performance metrics, to evaluate the effectiveness of marketing initiatives and optimize future strategies. 
Capability to provide training, resources, and support to channel partners to enhance their understanding of products/services and improve their sales effectiveness. 
Understanding of brand guidelines and ability to ensure consistent brand messaging and positioning across all channel marketing activities. 
Strong interpersonal and communication skills to effectively collaborate with internal teams (e.g., sales, product development, marketing) and external partners to align channel marketing activities with overall business goals; experience influencing price, distribution and merchandising placement across functions and levels as well as launching rewards/recognition/spiff programs. 
Experience in developing and managing channel marketing budgets, allocating resources effectively, and maximizing ROI. 
Ability to adapt to changing market conditions and develop creative solutions to address channel-specific challenges or opportunities; ability to execute against multiple priorities and excel in a fast-paced, results-oriented work environment. 
Skill in managing multiple projects simultaneously, setting priorities, and meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

description:
We’re seeking a forward-thinking Senior Product Manager to help lead the next generation of our AI suite, including our voice and live agent capabilities. Based in Mexico and partnering closely with engineering teams and enterprise customers across the Americas, you’ll own the full product lifecycle, from discovery through delivery, adoption, and iteration. You’ll drive the roadmap, collaborate cross-functionally, and build experiences that help our regulated enterprise customers scale engagement, improve service, and grow with confidence. This role combines senior product leadership with the exciting challenge of leveraging AI to solve real problems for customers in banking, credit unions, wealth management, insurance, and telecom.




Your Responsibilities

Innovation through Customer Insight

Engage directly with enterprise customers across the Americas through discovery interviews, advisory boards, and QBRs to uncover unmet needs and validate new ideas. Translate pain points into opportunities where conversational AI, automation, or personalization can drive breakthrough value.




AI-Driven Product Strategy

Collaborate on the vision and roadmap for our AI suite, including voice and live agent experiences, with a strong emphasis on embedding agentic and conversational capabilities. Partner with AI/ML and engineering teams to identify use cases such as agentic orchestration, voice automation, agent assist and co-pilot, smart routing, and conversational analytics. Evaluate build-vs-buy decisions and ensure technical feasibility, including the accuracy, governance, and compliance controls regulated customers require.




Channel + Ecosystem Integration

Lead product thinking around integrations with contact center (CCaaS), CRM, messaging, telephony, and other core systems to ensure customer context and knowledge are actionable and seamlessly integrated into customer conversations and workflows.




Execution & Delivery

Translate strategic goals into PRDs, epics, and user stories. Partner with engineering throughout the development lifecycle (sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release management) to deliver features that drive customer growth and retention. Collaborate with UX, product marketing, and sales enablement to ship products that add measurable value to enterprise customers. Ensure roadmap priorities are aligned with our key ICPs and target the most important product gaps based on competitive and market landscape.




Metrics-Driven Iteration

Define and track KPIs that reflect product success across the full lifecycle. Analyze adoption, retention, and usage patterns to refine experiences post-launch and inform prioritization decisions.




Go-to-Market Readiness

Lead cross-functional Go To Market activities for new launches and upgrades. Collaborate with product marketing, sales, and customer success to position our AI suite as a differentiator. Create enablement materials and ensure internal teams and enterprise clients can adopt and trust your product.




Product Lifecycle Ownership

Own the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation through development, launch, post-launch optimization, and end-of-life. Ensure each phase has clear success criteria and customer feedback loops. Drive continuous improvement through retrospectives and lessons learned.




Cross-Border Enterprise Collaboration

Work effectively across time zones with engineering, sales, customer success, and executive teams in the US and Latin America. Serve as the product voice in customer-facing meetings and executive reviews. Mentor junior product team members and help build PM best practices across the organization.

We’re a global, multidisciplinary team that’s putting the innovative power of technology to work and transforming tomorrow. As a member of HARMAN Lifestyle, you connect consumers with the power of superior sound.

About The Role

As part of the Trade Marketing team, the Trade Marketing Coordinator for Mexico will support the execution and follow-up of trade marketing initiatives across retail accounts. This role will coordinate with vendors, sales, clients, and the promoter team to ensure the successful execution of projects and in-store activities aligned with brand and commercial objectives in Mexico.

The Trade Marketing Coordinator will be responsible for managing vendors, working closely with the commercial team, and maintaining strong relationships with retail clients. This role will oversee the promoter’s teams for accounts, ensuring proper coverage, training, execution, and performance through defined KPIs. The coordinator will have budget control of his accounts, project coordination, and follow-up, development and execution of POP materials and displays, as well as in-store activations and retail events. Additionally, this role will analyze post-project results to identify opportunities and provide insights for future activations and continuous improvement.

What You Will Do


Help drive the trade marketing execution in Mexico
Project coordination: Coordinate the end-to-end execution of Trade Marketing projects, from briefing and planning to implementation and follow-up, working closely with vendors, Sales, retail clients, and the promoter team.

Monitor and follow up on promoter KPIs,
Budget control: Support the management and tracking of Trade Marketing budgets, including quotations, purchase orders, invoices, expense tracking and budget reconciliation. 
POP, displays, expos & retail communication: Coordinate the development, production and implementation of displays, planograms, POP materials, in-store communication and creative artworks, from briefing and adaptation through production and final execution, ensuring brand consistency and compliance with retailer specifications. 
In-store activations & retail events: Coordinate and execute in-store activations, retail events and special campaigns, including logistics, materials, promoters and overall brand experience. 
Post-project analysis: Analyze the results of projects, activations and retail initiatives, including sell-out impact, execution, budget performance and key learnings, identifying opportunities and recommendations for future initiatives.

#Hybrid

You Belong Here 

HARMAN is committed to making every employee feel welcomed, valued, and empowered. No matter what role you play, we encourage you to share your ideas, voice your distinct perspective, and bring your whole self with you – all within a support-minded culture that celebrates what makes each of us unique. We also recognize that learning is a lifelong pursuit and want you to flourish. We proudly offer added opportunities for training, development, and continuing education, further empowering you to live the career you want.

About HARMAN: Where Innovation Unleashes Next-Level Technology 

Ever since the 1920s, we’ve been amplifying the sense of sound. Today, that legacy endures, with integrated technology platforms that make the world smarter, safer, and more connected.

DiDi provides car owners, drivers, and delivery partners with flexible work and income opportunities. It is committed to collaborating with policymakers, the taxi industry, the automobile industry and the communities to solve the world’s transportation, environmental and employment challenges through the use of AI technology and localized smart transportation innovations. DiDi strives to create better life experiences and greater social value, by building a safe, inclusive and sustainable transportation and local services ecosystem for cities of the future.

For more information, please visit: www.didiglobal.com/news

About The Team/role

As a Product Operations Intern at DiDi, you will support the supply channel mid-platform team in driving high-quality execution of mobility and platform product initiatives across multiple markets; your work will enable faster feature rollouts, improved product reliability, and measurable improvements in user and driver satisfaction metrics.  Cross-Region Operations Communication & Support

We strive to always create valuable experiences for our users in everything we do. Our focus is to always innovate new experiences that are safe, pleasant and efficient.
